scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only: authorship of migration 0041, its rollback, and db suite 100. It asserts nothing about correctness; that is for CI (R4) and the CTO review (R2).

Suite 100: idempotent re-apply, per-present-table DML + PUBLIC-empty checks, live down/up cycle where directus_migrations exists (explicit skip otherwise).

doesNotClaimR2: There is no reviews[] entry here and there will not be one from me. R2 wants a named reviewer who is not the author. CTO R2 requested on the AFC-768 thread before landing.
notClaimedPaths: Nothing else in scope; this commit touches only the three claim paths.
